resources.string: Space always picks the middle suggestion, even when the keyboard isn\'t sure. Words the keyboard doesn\'t know stay in the middle as you typed them.
Typing punctuation like ! or ? corrects the word before it, just like space.
Typing punctuation keeps the word exactly as you typed it, and symbols become part of the word. Space still corrects.
autocorrect punctuation exclamation question mark comma period keep typed word

Autocorrect Threshold isn\'t used right now. \"Always use middle suggestion\" is on in Text Prediction, so space always takes the middle word without checking how sure the keyboard is. Turn that off to use this slider.
